comingLast.roast: off 27 on 20 - gallant to the end, blue to the finish
still swinging on 19 - hope dies on the 18th, usually
1 point of insurance at 1.4 a hole - premium unpaid
2 above Henman and in - now it is all spectator sport with stakes
in the clubhouse 2 above Henman - cheering for him from a safe distance
3 above the blue line - the bar keeps updating his odds
3 above Henman - one man's cushion is another man's target
in on a 4-point buffer - watching the door like everyone else
5 points clear from the bar - watching Henman like a hawk with a beer
done and dangling 5 above the blue balls - do not jinx it
